_comment: OPA-style capability policy (CLAUDE.md §8). Agents may NOT edit this file (§3). The Python policy engine (workflows/lib/policy.py) and the Rust control-plane both enforce these rules; this document is the data they share.

rules.no_secrets: Deny touching secrets and key material.
rules.no_network_in_airgap: Deny capability 'network' while airgap is on (§11).
rules.no_self_skill: Deny activating a skill created in the current run (§10).
rules.no_edit_under_test: Deny editing a file currently held by a test-env lease (§3, §5).
rules.bulk_delete_needs_approval: Deny deleting more than max_delete_without_approval files without human approval.
rules.scope_required: Every mutated path must match the token's scope (§8).
